name: پرس سینه TRX
review_notes: v001 (gemini_generated_video_7fc654fc) reviewed 2026-11-08: trainer faces the anchor side throughout; the straps run upward in front of the trainer and the anchor is cropped out. Both repetitions repeat the reversed setup. 1280x720; 10.03 s; audio track present. v002 (gemini_generated_video_86dd5566): anchor is behind the coach, but detached handles hang behind him while his hands move separate grips. Hands also descend toward the waist. v003 (gemini_generated_video_6844214f) reviewed 2026-11-09: anchor remains behind the coach and straps appear to reach the grips in sampled frames. Hands stay near the waist and elbows stay bent as the coach rocks forward and back. No chest-height press or near-straight finish. 1280x720; 10.03 s; audio track present. v004 (gemini_generated_video_9079acce) reviewed 2026-11-09: clearer opening reach and elbow movement. Grips drop beside the hips around 3–4 s; final hold is lower and more bent than the opening pose. 1280x720; 10.03 s; audio track present. v005 (gemini_generated_video_462aa469) reviewed at one-second intervals: returns to the opening arm extension. Around 2–4 s the handles descend beside the hips and the straps exit the frame at the top. 1280x720; 10.03 s; audio track present. v006 starts from the bent-elbow pose in the right panel of the catalog reference. v006 (gemini_generated_video_a2550adc) reviewed: grips remain above the waist and both arms visibly press forward. Top edge clips the mounting plate and the ending grips sit slightly higher than at the start. 1280x720; 10.03 s; audio track present. v007 (gemini_generated_video_67cbbbe4): visible press and recognizable coach. Opening and ending grips sit near the waist, and the mount touches the top edge. 1280x720; 10.03 s; non-silent AAC track. v008 specifies a chest-height path and an exact return to the loaded opening pose. Owner deferred this exercise for a later attempt with another model; proceed to trx-lunge.

name: لانج کمکی TRX
review_notes: v001 (gemini_generated_video_295a8e52) reviewed at half-second intervals: both feet remain outside the cradles and the coach returns to standing twice. The same near-side leg is forward in both bottom poses, and the planted shoe shifts forward. The overhead mount is outside the frame. 1280x720; 10.03 s; non-silent AAC. v002 (gemini_generated_video_ca330a18) improves anchor visibility, but its attachment reaches the top edge. Both bottom poses still show the same near-side front leg, and the front shoe shifts relative to the opening stance. 1280x720; 10.03 s; non-silent AAC. v003 (video.mp4) shows a forward leg lift and shallow single-leg dip. No rear foot plants behind the support foot, and the straps diverge toward opposite top edges. 1280x720; 10.03 s; AAC track. v004 (new video.mp4, 2668508 bytes) shows one shared anchor and a recognizable bottom position with rear toe contact. At about 1.5–2 s the lead shoe steps toward the anchor before descent, and the lead shoe returns at the end. Forward lunge entry. 1280x720; 10.03 s; AAC track. v005 (new video.mp4, 2498671 bytes) passes the owner’s roughly 80% review standard. One clear backward step with rear toe contact, a stable lead shoe at the floor mark and return to standing. Slight extra knee lift on return and tight anchor framing are acceptable. Published on 2026-11-09 with owner authorization. Silent 8-second 1280x720 H.264, 1066956 bytes. Separate catalog lookup and anonymous HTTP 206 verified; public SHA-256 matched the local export.
